title: Skiing (Hok Ski) Excursion in Jacques-Cartier National Park
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: We are very busy during the winter season and it's difficult to reach us by phone. For any information, please contact us by email or send us a text message on our phone.
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately for winter conditions.
Dress Winter clothing, warm coat or jacket, hat and gloves, dress in layers, hiking boots/leather boots or sneakers
Subject to favorable snow conditions. If canceled due to insufficient snow or bad weather, you will be given the option of an alternative date or full refund
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Just half an hour from downtown Quebec City, explore Jacques-Cartier National Park's winter landscape on a ski-shoeing hike, a mix between cross-country skiing and snowshoeing, for a memorable experience in this wilderness. With easy-to-follow techniques and ski-shoe gear provided, this 3-hour tour is suitable for beginners and experts alike. You’ll learn about Quebec forest, area's history, culture and nature along the way from your experienced guide and you'll capture great photos of the winter landscape. 

Ski-shoeing equipment, round-trip hotel transport and lunch are included on this small-group tour.
